questions.text: What does break do inside a loop?
options: It stops the loop completely, however many iterations were left
It skips the rest of this iteration and goes to the next one
It stops the whole program
It pauses the loop until the user presses Enter

questions.text: What does continue do inside a loop?
options: It stops the loop completely
It skips the rest of the current iteration and jumps to the next one
It runs the current iteration again from the top
It goes on with the line after the loop

questions.text: Once break runs, which line runs next?
options: The first line of the loop, for the next iteration
The line right under break, in the same block
The first line after the loop
None, the program ends there
